design.mergeLaw: MERGE only on check-run conclusion string success for Typecheck and Test on the SHA those conclusions belong to. gh pr checks printing pass is not the gate.
design.pinSha: HEAD of s1-flood-inspect at close. Currently 6074940dc18cd241b7cde54fda7fdde2fc8fd64c. Do not pin 682d56f1.
design.imageExistsOnlyAfterMainPush: build-and-push is push-to-main only and tags github.sha plus latest. deploy-canary does not build. image_tag must be a tag already in Artifact Registry.
design.squashTrap: PR mergeable_state=behind. A squash or merge-commit onto current main produces a different github.sha than 6074940. Deploy image_tag is that main-push SHA after Build & push conclusion success, not the PR head unless they are identical.
design.yamlMustBePostMergeMain: ATOMS_DATABASE_URL is on the PR branch yaml --set-secrets line. Dispatching workflow_dispatch against pre-merge main uses the old yaml and the new revision will not mount the secret.
